title: English Practice Quiz 0309
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Which is a complete sentence?
questions.explanation: The team finished the work contains a subject and a complete predicate.

questions.question: She ___ to work every day.
questions.explanation: With he, she or it in the present simple, add -s or -es to most verbs.

questions.question: We have a meeting ___ Monday.
questions.explanation: Use on with days and dates.

questions.question: Choose the correct question tag: 'You are ready, ___?'
questions.explanation: A positive statement with are usually takes the negative tag aren't you.

questions.question: He decided ___ early.
questions.explanation: Decide is commonly followed by a to-infinitive.

questions.question: He wants to become ___ engineer.
questions.explanation: Engineer begins with a vowel sound, so use an.

questions.question: Choose the correct WH question for a place.
questions.explanation: Where asks about a place or location.

questions.question: He speaks English ___.
questions.explanation: Clearly is the adverb describing how he speaks.

questions.question: Choose the best word: The road is very ___. There are many cars.
questions.explanation: Crowded means filled with many people or things; it can describe busy roads.

questions.question: You have completed a task. You say:
questions.explanation: The task is complete is a clear status update.
